scripts.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build && lefthook install && pnpm run doctor
scripts.doctor: test -d node_modules && lefthook validate && test -x "$(git rev-parse --git-path hooks/pre-commit)" && test -x "$(git rev-parse --git-path hooks/pre-push)" || { echo 'Setup incomplete; run pnpm run setup' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.check-all: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check-package && pnpm run type-check
